8: module GameData
9:   class Target
10:     attr_reader :id
11:     attr_reader :real_name
12:     attr_reader :num_targets        # 0, 1 or 2 (meaning 2+)
13:     attr_reader :targets_foe        # Is able to target one or more foes
14:     attr_reader :targets_all        # Crafty Shield can't protect from these moves
15:     attr_reader :affects_foe_side   # Pressure also affects these moves
16:     attr_reader :long_range         # Hits non-adjacent targets
17: 
18:     DATA = {}
19: 
20:     extend ClassMethodsSymbols
21:     include InstanceMethods
22: 
23:     def self.load; end
24:     def self.save; end
25: 
26:     def initialize(hash)
27:       @id               = hash[:id]
28:       @real_name        = hash[:name]             || "Unnamed"
29:       @num_targets      = hash[:num_targets]      || 0
30:       @targets_foe      = hash[:targets_foe]      || false
31:       @targets_all      = hash[:targets_all]      || false
32:       @affects_foe_side = hash[:affects_foe_side] || false
33:       @long_range       = hash[:long_range]       || false
34:     end
35: 
36:     # @return [String] the translated name of this target
37:     def name
38:       return _INTL(@real_name)
39:     end
40: 
41:     def can_choose_distant_target?
42:       return @num_targets == 1 && @long_range
43:     end
44: 
45:     def can_target_one_foe?
46:       return @num_targets == 1 && @targets_foe
47:     end
48:   end
49: end
